preferred_label: Ecce homo — German text embodied by the posthumous Richter/Insel edition of 1908

variant_labels.value: Ecce homo. Wie man wird — was man ist

notes: Edition-scoped source-language expression for Raoul Richter's posthumous 1908 Insel edition, which substantially follows the Köselitz copy and includes a separate editor's afterword. It is not silently equated with Nietzsche's lost author-approved state, Montinari's reconstruction, manuscript strata, or any modern critical text.
